hypothesis_input: hyp-her2-001-v2: T-DXd co-activates ferroptosis via DXd payload (topo-I inhibitor class). Mechanistic chain: DXd → TOP1mt poison → mtDNA breaks → mitochondrial dysfunction → ROS/lipid peroxidation → ferroptosis sensitization; concurrent HER2 internalization → PI3K-NRF2-SLC7A11 transcriptional suppression. SLC7A11-high HER2+ tumors escape. Composite 0.813, evidential quality 0.72. Key gap: DXd-specific ferroptosis data absent — evidence is CPT/SN-38 class analogy (PMID 37735740, 31723605).

sub_questions.question: Is there any published preclinical or clinical data directly linking T-DXd or its payload (DXd/exatecan) to ferroptosis, lipid peroxidation, or GPX4/SLC7A11 modulation in HER2+ breast cancer?
sub_questions.rationale: The entire mechanistic chain is extrapolated from CPT-class analogy. A single paper showing DXd directly induces lipid peroxidation or GPX4/SLC7A11 changes would elevate evidential quality from 0.72 to ≥0.85. Conversely, confirming the gap validates the novelty claim.

sub_questions.question: In DESTINY-Breast clinical trials (DB-01/02/03/04), are there reported adverse events or biomarker patterns consistent with ferroptosis (iron dyshomeostasis, lipid peroxidation, anemia pattern) in T-DXd responders vs non-responders?
sub_questions.rationale: Ferroptosis in vivo would manifest as: hemolytic-type anemia, ferritin elevation, liver transaminase changes from lipid peroxidation. DESTINY-Breast safety data may contain indirect signatures. Also: is SLC7A11 measured in any DESTINY-Breast translational sub-study?

sub_questions.question: What is the detailed NRF2-SLC7A11 transcriptional regulation mechanism downstream of PI3K inhibition by HER2 antibody engagement, and does trastuzumab alone reduce SLC7A11 expression in HER2+ cell lines?
sub_questions.rationale: The PI3K→NRF2→SLC7A11 transcriptional axis is the second arm of the hypothesis. NRF2 is regulated transcriptionally and post-translationally by KEAP1. PI3K inhibition reduces AKT→GSK3β→NRF2 stabilization. Need to confirm: (a) trastuzumab component reduces PI3K-NRF2-SLC7A11 axis, (b) this is additive with DXd ferroptosis sensitization.

sub_questions.question: What is the optimal preclinical experimental protocol to confirm the DXd → mitochondrial ROS → ferroptosis → SLC7A11-stratified response axis, and what are the required controls to rule out alternative cell death mechanisms (apoptosis, necroptosis)?
sub_questions.rationale: This is the definitive experiment design. Requires: (1) BT-474 and SK-BR-3 HER2+ cell lines; (2) DXd or exatecan treatment; (3) ferroptosis readouts: 4-HNE IHC, C11-BODIPY lipid peroxidation, ferrostatin-1 rescue; (4) SLC7A11 high/low isogenic lines or SLC7A11-overexpressing controls; (5) apoptosis controls: Z-VAD-FMK; (6) necroptosis controls: necrostatin-1. Full power analysis for in vivo PDX model as confirmatory.

experiment_nodes.sub_question: SQ-1: Any published T-DXd or DXd/exatecan + ferroptosis data?

protocol.query_strategy: Phase 1: 'T-DXd ferroptosis' → Phase 1b: 'trastuzumab deruxtecan lipid peroxidation' → Phase 1c: 'deruxtecan GPX4 SLC7A11' → Phase 2: 'exatecan ferroptosis' → Phase 2b: 'topoisomerase I inhibitor ferroptosis HER2'
protocol.analysis_method: For any hit: extract if DXd/T-DXd is explicitly studied (not just CPT/SN-38 class), what ferroptosis readout was used, and whether SLC7A11 was measured. Confirm gap if zero results.
protocol.success_metric: Find at least one study using T-DXd or DXd and measuring ferroptosis markers — would confirm the mechanistic link directly.
protocol.failure_criterion: Zero results = GAP_CONFIRMED, which supports novelty. Not a failure for the hypothesis.

experiment_nodes.key_finding: PMID 39243601: T-DXd induces ferroptosis via crVDAC3-HSPB1 mitochondrial axis in HER2-low BC. Direct T-DXd ferroptosis confirmation. Hypothesis upgraded v2→v3 (0.813→0.851).

experiment_nodes.sub_question: SQ-2: DESTINY-Breast ferroptosis-consistent AEs + SLC7A11 translational sub-studies

protocol.query_strategy: Phase 1: 'DESTINY-Breast SLC7A11' → Phase 1b: 'T-DXd anemia iron' → Phase 1c: 'trastuzumab deruxtecan biomarker translational' → ClinicalTrials.gov: search NCT03248492 (DB-01), NCT04494425 (DB-04) sub-studies
protocol.analysis_method: Extract safety AE tables from DESTINY-Breast publications for iron-metabolism, liver, or lipid-related toxicities. Check if any translational sub-study measured SLC7A11, NRF2, or oxidative stress markers.
protocol.success_metric: Find SLC7A11 measurement in any DESTINY-Breast sub-study OR find iron/lipid peroxidation AE pattern.
protocol.failure_criterion: No SLC7A11 data and no ferroptosis-consistent AE pattern in clinical data — pure mechanistic gap requiring preclinical work.

experiment_nodes.key_finding: PMID 40464376 (eLife 2025): SLC7A11 epigenetically upregulated as trastuzumab resistance mechanism in HER2+ BC. No DESTINY-Breast translational sub-study has measured SLC7A11. Hypothesis refined to v4: T-DXd weaponizes trastuzumab-resistance-acquired SLC7A11 upregulation via ferroptosis.

experiment_nodes.sub_question: SQ-3: PI3K→NRF2→SLC7A11 axis under trastuzumab/HER2 internalization

protocol.query_strategy: Phase 1: 'NRF2 SLC7A11 PI3K trastuzumab' → Phase 1b: 'HER2 PI3K AKT NRF2 KEAP1' → Phase 1c: 'trastuzumab SLC7A11 expression breast cancer' → Reactome: pathway R-HSA-5669034 (NRF2 target gene regulation)
protocol.analysis_method: Map trastuzumab → HER2 downregulation → PI3K-AKT reduction → GSK3β activation → NRF2 destabilization (KEAP1-mediated) → SLC7A11 transcription drop. Confirm each arrow has published evidence. Check for published trastuzumab + SLC7A11 data in BT-474 or SK-BR-3.
protocol.success_metric: Complete mechanistic chain with at least 2 published steps directly evidenced in HER2+ context.
protocol.failure_criterion: NRF2-SLC7A11 arm is not modulated by trastuzumab alone — would require that DXd alone drives all ferroptosis sensitivity.

experiment_nodes.key_finding: Reactome R-HSA-9762114 (GSK3B→BTRC:CUL1 NRF2 degradation) + R-HSA-9818027 (AcK-NFE2L2/ATF4 activate SLC7A11 gene). Full PI3K-GSK3β-NRF2-SLC7A11 chain confirmed. SLC7A11 paradox resolved: double-hit model — antibody strips cytosolic SLC7A11, DXd delivers mitochondrial ferroptosis bypassing GPX4/SLC7A11. Hypothesis upgraded v4→v5 (0.881→0.903).

experiment_nodes.sub_question: SQ-4: Definitive preclinical protocol — DXd ferroptosis + SLC7A11 stratification

slc7a11_stratification_arms: Erastin co-treatment (SLC7A11 inhibitor, positive ferroptosis control)
experimental_design.in_vivo_extension: BT-474 xenograft in NSG mice; T-DXd 10mg/kg Q3W × 3; tumor harvest at day 21; 4-HNE IHC + SLC7A11 H-score by IHC; split into SLC7A11-high vs low by median H-score
experimental_design.power_calculation: n=6/arm in vivo, α=0.05, power=0.80 for 40% tumor volume difference (based on CPT-11 ferroptosis data PMID 37735740)

protocol.success_metric: Ferrostatin-1 rescue ≥30% viability vs untreated (confirms ferroptosis as T-DXd death mechanism). SLC7A11-high resistance ≥2-fold IC50 increase vs SLC7A11-low.
protocol.failure_criterion: Ferrostatin-1 rescue <10% — ferroptosis is not a major T-DXd mechanism; hypothesis requires revision to focus solely on NRF2-mediated sensitization without topo-I ferroptosis link.

best_path_so_far: n0-root → HER2-EXP-001 (CRITICAL_POSITIVE: PMID 39243601, score 0.851) → HER2-EXP-002 (PMID 40464376 trastuzumab-resistance anchor, score 0.881) → HER2-EXP-003 (Reactome R-HSA-9762114+R-HSA-9818027 confirmed, paradox resolved, score 0.903)

hypothesis: T-DXd co-activates ferroptosis via its DXd payload (topo-I class) in HER2+ breast cancer. Mechanism: DXd → TOP1mt poison → mitochondrial ROS → lipid peroxidation; HER2 internalization → PI3K-NRF2-SLC7A11 transcriptional suppression. SLC7A11-high tumors escape and may explain primary T-DXd resistance.

evidence.finding: CPT-11 (same pharmacological class as DXd) induces ferroptosis via ALOX15/GPX4/SLC7A11
SN-38 (CPT metabolite) causes TOP1mt poisoning and mitochondrial dysfunction
Topo-I inhibitors activate ferroptosis axis in colorectal cancer
NRF2 directly transcribes SLC7A11 — establishes the PI3K-NRF2-SLC7A11 axis
SLC7A11 CV=59.4% within HER2-enriched (n=78), Q1=104 vs Q3=276 RSEM

novelty_claim: No published study has directly tested DXd/T-DXd for ferroptosis induction in HER2+ breast cancer. SLC7A11 IHC as T-DXd response stratifier is entirely novel. The synergistic mechanism (payload ferroptosis + antibody NRF2 suppression) has not been proposed before.
actionability: Next: run HER2-EXP-001 (literature gap) to confirm T-DXd ferroptosis gap, then chain to HER2-EXP-002 + HER2-EXP-003 in parallel, then HER2-EXP-004 (cell line protocol design).
